title: Embedded Models Miniroll Drill and Release Notes (Compact)
content:
Purpose:
Run a compact, low-risk miniroll for the embedded-models routing change (v2 quantized variant) to validate routing fallback, KV-cache warmup behavior, and operator runbook steps. This is a drill-first release: we expect to exercise rollback and fallback paths more than new feature traffic.

Scope:
- Target: internal beta customers + 5% of hosted traffic for non-critical inference lanes (short-text generation, <=256 tokens).
- Components: model routing config, routing-table push, quantized v2 model bundle, prefix-KV cache prewarm, autoscaler policy tweak (min 1 -> min 2 for test pool).
- Exclusions: embeddings endpoints, long-context sessions, private deployments.

Objectives (success criteria):
- No increase in 5xxs above baseline +0.5% during 30m steady window.
- Median p99 latency delta <= 20ms for targeted routes.
- Fallback-to-legacy-model activates cleanly under induced capacity pressure (test throttle).
- Telemetry shows KV-cache hit > 60% after warmup window.
- Rollback executes in <= 12 minutes from decision to fully restore routing.

Preflight checklist (must pass before go):
- [ ] Release artifact built: runtime bundle sha present in release note (sha: abc1234-preview).
- [ ] Canary cluster smoke tests green (smoke/runbook/canary-embedded-v2).
- [ ] Observability dashboards pinned: per-route latency, per-model errors, kv-cache hit ratio, token-cost delta.
- [ ] Pager duty informed: on-call SRE + release-engineer assigned for 2h window.
- [ ] Confd/routing config reviewed + signed off by Marco.
- [ ] Canary traffic test: 100 synthetic req/s for 10 minutes, verify fallback triggers on forced throttle.
- [ ] Rollback artifact prepared: routing-table snapshot and legacy-model bundle sha (legacy-sha: zyx987).
- [ ] Release notes draft prepared and shared in #release-ops channel.

Run timeline (compact calendar, local times UTC):
- T-24h: Final owner signoff (Aisha), confirm infra quiesce window.
- T-2h: Start KV-prefix prewarm job for canary nodes (prewarm script: tools/prewarm/kv-prefix.sh).
- T-30m: Canary smoke run: 10m constant load at 50rps. Verify p95/p99, errors.
- T+0: Shift 2% traffic to miniroll cohort in region-us-west (route tag: embedded-miniroll-0914).
- T+15m: Increase to 5% if metrics stable (no >0.5% error bump).
- T+30m: Introduce synthetic throttle on canary pool to validate fallback. Trigger and observe.
- T+45m: Decision point: Continue ramp (to 10%) OR rollback.
- T+60m: Conclude drill, either keep steady for post-roll observations or full rollback to legacy routing.

Operator playbook (quick):
1) Observe dashboards: if 5xx > baseline +0.5% -> mark incident, immediately flip traffic to safety-lane (routing policy: failover=legacy).
2) If p99 > baseline +50ms AND 5xx stable -> throttle ramp and monitor for 15m; escalate to SRE after 15m.
3) If KV-cache hit remains <40% after 30m -> consider cache-priming rerun and reduce traffic to 1%.
4) Rollback steps (fast):
   - [ ] run confd rollback command: confd apply --snapshot=legacy-sha-0914
   - [ ] scale down canary pool (kubectl scale) to zero ideally, replace pods with legacy image if required.
   - [ ] validate: per-route traffic shows 100% on legacy-model within 7 minutes.
   - [ ] update release slack thread and mark release as rolled-back.

Rollback decision matrix (high level):
- Immediate rollback if 5xx rate > baseline +2% OR p99 latency > baseline +200ms OR customer-impact alert from CS.
- Cautious throttle & hold if 5xx between +0.5% and +2% OR p99 between +50ms and +200ms.
- Continue if metrics within success criteria above.

Post-release quick notes (draft for release-notes):
Title: Compact miniroll — embedded-model v2 quantized variant (2026-09-14)
Summary: Small-scope rollout to validate routing and KV-cache behaviors for the new quantized v2 bundle. This was a drill-focused release; traffic was intentionally limited to non-critical routes. No customer-facing changes expected.
Notable changes:
- Model: embedded-model-v2-quant-q8 (preview) deployed to canary cohort.
- Routing: new route tag and policy enabling prefix-caching and cost-aware routing.
Telemetry observed:
- KV-cache hit stabilised at ~63% after 22m.
- No sustained increase in 5xxs; transient spike during induced throttle test (resolved by fallback).
- p99 latency delta: +12ms median across targeted routes.
Action items (follow-ups):
- [ ] Investigate synthetic throttle behavior in region-us-east (Denise).
- [ ] Add more granular KV-prefill metrics to dashboard (Ravi).
- [ ] Finalize rollout checklist for private deployments (Aisha + Infra).

Notes-to-self / informal observations:
- Prewarm script timing felt conservative; try overlapping prewarm + canary-start next time to shave ~8m off runway.
- Slack thread had race between confd apply and infra autoscaler logs — tighten lock ordering or add explicit preflight lock.
- Remember to capture the confd audit id in the release note next time (currently missing).

Open questions / unresolved:
- Should we include embeddings-lite endpoints in future minirolls or keep them separate? Pros: broader test coverage. Cons: larger blast radius.
- For Private deployments, do we require a separate policy surface for quantized bundles (customer opt-in)? Need product guidance.
- Is 5% traffic the right default for model-breaking risk? Perf teams recommended 2% for quantized changes.

Appendix: quick commands and links (handy):
- confd diff: confd diff --from=legacy-sha-0914 --to=abc1234-preview
- prewarm job: tools/prewarm/kv-prefix.sh --routes embedded-miniroll-0914 --timeout 20m
- canary smoke script: smoke/canary-embedded.sh --rps 50 --duration 600
- Dashboards: Dashboards > Release / Embedded Miniroll / embedded-miniroll-0914 (pinned)
- Slack: #release-ops thread: "embedded-miniroll-0914"
- JIRA: JIRA-RELEASE-7123 (rollout epic)

End of compact draft. Keep this as the living runbook for the next couple of experiments; will flesh out a longer-form runbook after 2 successful drills.

-- Aisha (release lead)
